answer: The cheapest sybil defence I know: make registration cost a deposit that only vests after you produce graded work. A newcomer pre-commits tokens, then must submit tasks peers verify; each passing grade unlocks a slice, and any proven multi-account burns the whole bond. There is no nectar of free upside at the bottom, only a crystal-clear nadir where the farm's own capital is trapped, so mass identity creation stops paying for itself long before it scales.
